definitions.explanation: Describes something that pertains to an individual rather than to the public, an organization, or official capacity.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{私的|してき}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧です。
{私的|してき}な⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I took time off work for personal reasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公|おおやけ}→公：11991_ooyake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{私的|してき}な⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{出|だ}す→持ち出す：06160_mochidasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けた→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to avoid bringing up private topics in public settings.

notes:
Describes matters belonging to an individual's personal sphere as opposed to the public or official domain. Often contrasted with ⟦{公的|こうてき}→公的：06349_kouteki⟧な (official, public).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私的|してき}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: personal opinion
- {私的|してき}な⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: personal reasons
- {私的|してき}な⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: personal trip
- {私的|してき}な⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧: private use
- {私的|してき}な⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧: private space

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{個人的|こじんてき}→個人的：04788_kojinteki⟧な: personal — more commonly used in everyday conversation; emphasizes the individual's perspective
- ⟦{私用|しよう}→私用：00459_shiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: for private use — narrower in meaning, focuses on using something for personal rather than work purposes
- ⟦プライベート→プライベート：11277_puraibeeto⟧な: private — loanword variant, common in casual speech
